title: Akiyama Mizuki — Embroidery Enjoyment〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hehe. Guess what?
I found this really cute wrapping paper.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <The gifts I talked about are gonna look really amazing now!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Oh, right. It's only a week away.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yup! And I'm super excited about our party in SEKAI!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Oh, how about the rest of you?
Do you have your gifts ready?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Wow, already?! You must be pretty stoked, Enanan!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess. Miku and the others seem like they're looking forward to it, that's all.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Mine should be ready by the day of.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I've more or less decided what I'm going to get.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I'm trying not to get the same things as someone else, so can I ask what you're all going to bring?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I thought the idea was to keep what's inside the presents a secret.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <But I am a little worried about whether or not my gift choices are appropriate.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I guess a tiny hint wouldn't hurt, if it means making K feel a little better?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I'd rather not make you stress out over this for an entire week.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <By the way, mine are pretty much exactly what you'd think when you think Valentine's Day gifts.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <That's not a hint, that's just the answer.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You gotta be more roundabout. For example... Say it's food, or that it's brand goods or something.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Did you buy chocolates from a famous brand, Enanan?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I had a feeling that you were thinking about the gifts you got.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I-I'm sorry for making you all do this...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I mean, it doesn't have to be top-secret...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Exactly! The thought you put into your gift matters way more than what you actually get.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, I think it's totally fine if you just happened to get the same thing as someone else.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, K, can you give us a clue regarding what you got for everyone?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Umm... I thought everyone would be getting chocolates, so I decided to go with something crispy.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<No, nothing's wrong.
I was just thinking that it'll probably go well with chocolate!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I'm really looking forward to your gift now, K!>
